domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 辙叉中心处具有尖端并参与承载过渡的轨件。
usage_note: 本文与wing rail对照描述轮轨接触及轮载过渡。
usage_overview: 心轨在车轮通过辙叉时参与轮轨接触与承载过渡，在轮载转移过程中接替翼轨支承车轮；分析辙叉区域的接触变化时，需区分心轨与翼轨的承载作用。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

P037.title: Matrix coupled model for the vehicle–track interaction analysis featured to the railway crossing
P037.label: Xu等（2021）

complete_examples.text: To deal with this situation, the transition region is divided into two parts according to the Y-coordinate range of the wing rail and the nose rail, as denoted by Hwing and Hnose.

Following Equation (5), it can be regarded that when swing 6 0 and snose > 0, the wheel contacts the nose rail; when swing > 0 and snose 6 0, the wheel contacts the wing rail; when swing > 0 and snose > 0, the wheel contacts the wing and nose rail simultaneously, and when swing 6 0 and snose 6 0, the wheel loses contact with the rail.
